input_contract_excerpt: ERROR [DEPTH_NOT_TRAINED_FORM] input has 17 slices; this recipe trained on 21 (a 17-slice window cut from it). A 17-slice CT is not that representation (e.g. an unpooled level-2 crop). Prepare the input with prepare_9um_isotropic_input: centred 84 planes, mean-pooled by 4
guard_exception: FloatingPointError: model produced non-finite probabilities; the output would be written as zeros. Half precision overflows on some GPUs: rerun with --amp-dtype (full precision where the GPU supports it)
full_precision_parity_basis: Historical RUN_LOG.md reports six full-precision outputs identical to unmodified-main no-autocast references (max absolute difference 0); not rerun for packaging.
claim_limits: The 17/21-slice examples have different crops and labels; no causal depth/accuracy comparison.
Precision control is credited to Villa #1890.
Warnings are default; strict input refusal is opt-in. Numerical refusal always applies.
A successful finite prediction does not establish true negative ink.
